text:
Which statement is correct for a hair dryer with a double-insulated outer casing?
A
It does not need a fuse or an earth wire.
B
It needs an earth wire but not a fuse.
C
It needs a fuse but not an earth wire.
D
It needs a fuse and an earth wire.

options.label: A
options.text: It does not need a fuse or an earth wire.

options.label: B
options.text: It needs an earth wire but not a fuse.

options.label: C
options.text: It needs a fuse but not an earth wire.

options.label: D
options.text: It needs a fuse and an earth wire.
